name: BnS: Fidget's Farming Folly
source:
Welcome to Magical Farm School, here in the Big and Small World. Perhaps you'll find something nice... or not.


Fidget joins magical farming school, however despite being surrounded by friends, something feels wrong here.

[From [url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/big-and-small-magical-farm-school-or-something]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到神奇农场学校，这里位于大大小小的世界。也许你会发现一些好东西……或者没有。


Fidget加入了魔法农场学校，然而尽管周围都是朋友，但这里却感觉有些不对劲。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/big-and-small-magical-farm-school-or-something]itch.io[/url]]
